Project Overview & Purpose

Color Blindness Assistant is an applied AI research initiative tackling the real-world challenge of career orientation for individuals with color vision deficiency. High school students with color blindness often face restricted career pathways or misinformation regarding suitable professional fields. This system combines data-driven insights and assistive AI guidance to evaluate career compatibility with empathy and analytical precision.

Core Objective:To empower students with color vision deficiency by offering objective, data-backed career path analysis tailored to their visual profiles and interests.
My Role & Technical Contributions
Role: Data Analyst & AI Research Collaborator
  • Conducted thorough problem analysis and stakeholder requirements scoping for color vision deficiency challenges.
  • Performed comprehensive data collection and domain research on career suitability and color-dependent vocations.
  • Executed data preprocessing, cleaning, and exploratory data analysis (EDA) to ensure quality dataset inputs.
  • Supported model development workflow, parameter experimentation, and iterative validation.
